description: This file defines a PHP class `EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData` that implements report data processing for an Employee Leave Entitlement Usage Report in the OrangeHRM system. It uses multiple traits and interacts with various service classes to fetch leave types, balances, and other information to generate report data and metadata.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData
classes.description: A class that prepares and provides report data and metadata for employee leave entitlement usage, based on specified filter parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates an array of leave entitlement data entries with formatted values and URLs for viewing detailed leave information.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the report, such as total leave types count and employee info.
